title: DCA Safe
tagline: Buy your favorite undervalued token/ETH autonomously via your SAFE
description: I aimed to build a plugin with Gnosis Safe's safe protocol. This would allow onchain orgs/treasuries to autonomously purchase ETH/their favorite undervalued token through their SAFE. I wanted to build a frontend as well that could help give insight into the onchain purchases, what price they were happening at and more parameters to adjust for the safe signers.
how_its_made:
This product aimed to build a plugin using the safe protocol specs. Also, on the roadmap was to implemnent onebalance with gelato to achieve full autonomous purchase for onchain orgs/daos. This was pieced together with a lot of out of the box templates provided by the safe team and then solidity on top and lots of ethers js.

It was a fun hack!
